set.body:
## Outcome and owner
Add a reusable, topology-preserving coordinate-smoothing API in mesh4s-geometry. Owner: mesh4s geometry maintainer. Priority P2, feature; implementation not started. This is a basic mesh algorithm, not neuroimaging policy or scalar-field smoothing.

## Motivation and evidence
During PLS Neuro V4 review on 2026-09-22, the user accepted the pictured beta/FIR states but described the inflated surfaces as a little rough and suggested one or two smoothing iterations. The user explicitly requested native tickets in mesh4s and ScalaFIM. This motivates a bounded display experiment; geometry roughness versus normal/curvature shading has not yet been diagnosed. Do not promise that smoothing will improve these images.
Local inspected mesh4s main dfcb875 provides TriangleTopology neighbour/boundary traversal and typed SurfaceRealization/PointField coordinates, but no geometry smoothing API was found. Refresh current branches, adoption candidates and reservations before implementation; do not assume this older main is the correct implementation base.

## Scope and contract
- Implement in modules/mesh4s-geometry/shared with relevant laws/reference tests and public documentation. Reuse TriangleTopology, SurfaceRealization, PointField and typed coordinate frames; no application-name branches or duplicated adjacency owner.
- Return new coordinates bound to the exact same topology owner, vertex order, face indices and coordinate frame. Do not mutate input arrays or remesh/reindex. Zero iterations is an explicit identity operation.
- Choose and document a bounded smoothing scheme and weighting policy; expose validated iteration/step parameters, explicit fixed/free boundary behavior and optional constrained vertices if required by the chosen scope. Make synchronous iteration semantics explicit so vertex traversal order does not change the result.
- Define behavior for isolated vertices, boundaries, invalid parameters, nonfinite coordinates and unsupported topology/degenerate geometry. Respect the existing topology admission contract. Do not silently repair or drop faces.
- Assess displacement, area/volume/shape drift and degeneracy for the chosen method. Document limitations; topology preservation alone does not guarantee geometric validity or absence of self-intersections. Compare shrinkage-controlled alternatives only if the simple bounded scheme fails the declared shape budget; do not add an unbounded algorithm catalog.
- Do not smooth attached scientific/scalar fields. Normals may be recomputed by the geometry/view integration from the resulting coordinates; keep that responsibility explicit.

## Acceptance evidence
1. Independent hand-computable mesh fixtures or an independent reference calculate one and two iterations; include zero-iteration identity, fixed boundary/constrained vertices, isolated vertices and invalid inputs.
2. Exact same topology/frame ownership and unchanged input coordinates/attached fields; finite outputs or typed refusal. Test translation/rotation equivariance and scale behavior with declared tolerances, plus order independence under consistent relabeling.
3. Demonstrate bounded displacement and record area/volume changes and face degeneracy on synthetic and representative cortical-size geometry. Freeze tolerances before accepting results; do not claim that shape distortion is harmless merely because a picture looks smoother.
4. JVM and Scala.js tests, required optimized-JS/library gates, warning-clean compilation and a public example. Record exact commit, runtime and allocation/timing evidence at representative vertex counts; report preparation separately from each iteration.
5. Downstream ScalaFIM can consume the public API without copying its kernel. No consumer pin/admission or release is implied by this ticket's implementation completion.

## Coordination and exclusions
ScalaFIM owns applying a derived realization to an inflated display family, recomputed rendering normals, persistence/provenance, unchanged anatomical sampling and pick identity. PLS Neuro owns presentation controls and matched visual review. Existing consumer polish issue: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/.mote, bd-01M1YJNKZ6MF164N604WD8HJRY. Existing broader V4: bd-01M26XMYR2YVQWNXKM4HSHV5NJ in that foreign store. Cross-store IDs are provenance, not Mote dependency edges. Do not reopen the historical core/migration epic merely to add this capability. Implementation scope does not authorize publishing or changing defaults.
set.title: Add topology-preserving coordinate smoothing to mesh4s-geometry
